About the Thursday Community Road Ride (East Coast Bicycles) group ride

The shop's mid-pace road ride, 20 miles at 15 to 17 mph. Faster A and B groups go out Tuesdays at 6 and Saturdays at 7 am; Monday nights are a mixed-bag ride with changing themes. ID, helmet and lights required; no headphones.
